records.subject: Welcome aboard, Bright Studio
records.body:
Hi Maya,

Great to have you. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, but if you'd rather skip ahead, the important part is just getting real work into it rather than a placeholder.

Reply here with any questions.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.text: :tada: New signup: *Bright Studio* just joined on the starter plan!

decisions.rationale: Signed up 6 days ago, reached first_project within hours and sent 1 invite ([email:0238f8b1]), so real intent exists; but no key_milestone and no customer reply to two Wrenfield emails ([email:379d1b0d]), no tickets. Early momentum plus 8 days left suggests a moderate, under-even unaided chance.

draft.subject: Getting Bright Studio's first project moving
draft.body:
Hi Maya,

Nice work getting your first project set up last week, and I saw you've already invited a teammate. Projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so adding the real work you're tracking is usually the moment the picture clicks.

If it's helpful, I'm happy to jump on a short call this week to walk through how you'd like Bright Studio's work laid out, or I can answer it over email if that's easier.

Best,
Priya
